sentences.text: Three-strand twisted line is easy to splice and stretches well, which suits anchor rodes.
Double-braid line is strong and smooth, easier on hands and winches.
Chafe is the biggest enemy of line, so protect lines where they pass through chocks or over edges with chafe gear.
Rinse out salt and store lines out of the sun.
Remember that tying a knot in a line can reduce its strength by a third or more, while a good splice keeps most of it.
